testcase.name: Scenario: Add and remove a quick access command: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add and remove a quick access command ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon ✔ And Print is not present on the toolbar ✔ And New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are present on the toolbar ✔ When the user opens the quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print is unchecked ✔ And New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are checked ✔ When the user selects Print ✔ Then a Print icon appears on the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user reopens the customization menu ✔ Then Print is checked ✔ When the user selects Print again ✔ Then the Print icon is removed from the toolbar ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Move the quick access toolbar below and above the ribbon: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:21:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move the quick access toolbar below and above the ribbon ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon ✔ And Print is visible on the toolbar ✔ When the user opens the quick access customization menu ✔ And the user chooses Show Below the Ribbon ✔ Then the quick access toolbar appears in a row below the ribbon ✔ And Print remains visible on the toolbar ✔ When the user reopens the customization menu ✔ Then Print is checked ✔ And Show Above the Ribbon is offered ✔ When the user chooses Show Above the Ribbon ✔ Then the quick access toolbar returns above the ribbon ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:36:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude is available on the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon ✔ Then its context menu offers Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ Then an Extrude icon appears on the quick access toolbar ✔ And Extrude remains available on the ribbon ✔ When the user right-clicks the added quick access icon ✔ Then its context menu offers Remove from Quick Access Toolbar ✔ When the user chooses Remove from Quick Access Toolbar ✔ Then the added icon disappears from the quick access toolbar ✔ And Extrude remains available on the ribbon ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Add a separator from a toolbar command context menu: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:52:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add a separator from a toolbar command context menu ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks its quick access icon ✔ Then the context menu offers Add Separator ✔ When the user chooses Add Separator ✔ Then the quick access row gains a narrow divider beside the added command ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Invoke an added command from quick access in an empty part: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:61:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Invoke an added command from quick access in an empty part ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is active ✔ When the user selects the Extrude quick access icon ✔ Then the workspace displays the origin planes for selection ✔ And Start 2D Sketch is highlighted on the ribbon ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the origin plane selection display closes ✔ And the empty part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Invoke an added shortcut while another ribbon tab is active: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:72:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Invoke an added shortcut while another ribbon tab is active ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from 3D Model ✔ When the user selects the View ribbon tab ✔ Then the Extrude quick access icon remains visible ✔ When the user selects the Extrude quick access icon ✔ Then the origin planes are displayed for selection ✔ And the View ribbon remains displayed ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the origin plane selection display closes ✔ And the empty part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:85:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly ✔ Given two parts and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the first part is active ✔ And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from its ribbon ✔ When the user activates the assembly document ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is not shown on its quick access toolbar ✔ When the user reactivates the first part ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is visible again ✔ When the user activates the second part ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is visible there as well ✔ And the second part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:97:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled ✔ When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is disabled ✔ When the user dismisses the menu and remove the Extrude quick access icon ✔ And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled

testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts: tmp/obk-qat-full-pinned-20261115/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:111:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts ✔ Given a part and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Print is not selected in either document's quick access customization menu ✔ When the user activates the part and selects Print in its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print appears on the part's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user activates the assembly ✔ Then Print is absent from the assembly's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user opens its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print is unchecked ✔ When the user returns to the part ✔ Then Print is visible on the part's quick access toolbar ✔ When the user opens its quick access customization menu ✔ Then Print is checked ✔ When the user selects Print again ✔ Then Print is removed from the part's quick access toolbar

testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show Redo disabled when no redo action is available ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Redo is present on the quick access toolbar ✔ And no redo action is available in the active document ✔ When the user inspects the quick access toolbar ✔ Then Redo remains visible but disabled ✔ And the active part remains open
